title: KeyCredential
description: Contains a key credential (certificate) associated with an application or service principal.

endDateTime.description: The date and time at which the credential expires.

key.description: The certificate raw data in byte array converted to Base64 string.

type.description: The type of key credential (e.g., AsymmetricX509Cert).

usage.description: Describes the purpose of the key. Valid values are Verify and Sign.
